message.content:
I don’t have real‑time market data, so I can’t give you the exact spot price of gold for today. For the most accurate and up‑to‑date figure, check one of the following trusted sources:

| Source | How to find the price |
|--------|-----------------------|
| **Bloomberg** | Search “Gold Spot” on Bloomberg.com or use the Bloomberg terminal (ticker XAUUSD). |
| **Reuters** | Look up “Gold” on Reuters.com; they publish daily spot prices. |
| **Kitco** | Visit Kitco.com – they provide live charts and the current spot price. |
| **London Bullion Market Association (LBMA)** | Their “Gold Price” page shows the official London fix. |
| **U.S. Mint** | While the Mint doesn’t publish spot prices, it offers reference prices for bullion coins. |

If you’re looking for the price per ounce in U.S. dollars, the spot price is usually quoted in USD/oz. You can also use financial news apps (e.g., CNBC, Yahoo Finance) or commodity trading platforms that display live gold prices.

According to policy, we should not fabricate or guess. We can say we don't have real-time data. We can suggest checking reliable sources like Bloomberg, Reuters, or the US Mint website. We can also mention typical sources. So answer: I don't have real-time data. Suggest checking websites.
